name: heimdall
description: Heimdall deployment center for controlled ECS deployments across dev, stage, and prod.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @heimdall/shared && npm run build -w @heimdall/api && npm run build -w @heimdall/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @heimdall/shared && npm run test -w @heimdall/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @heimdall/shared && npm run typecheck -w @heimdall/api && npm run typecheck -w @heimdall/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @heimdall/shared && npm run lint -w @heimdall/api && npm run lint -w @heimdall/web
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
